fact_text: Wahdat Poultry Farm was founded in 2007 in Sargodha and presents itself as a supplier of branded, nutritionally enriched eggs in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat's revenue is about PKR 3 billion, as stated by the company in the April 2026 interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat runs a vertically integrated model covering its own feed, rearing, egg production, packing and distribution rather than buying in each stage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat markets its eggs as omega-3 enriched and as a certified, branded product sold through its own packaging.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat makes its own pulp-based egg packs in a dedicated packing unit alongside its farms.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat rears its own birds from one-day chicks until they start laying, a stage the CEO said the industry usually outsources.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said keeping rearing in-house lets Wahdat enforce health standards and vaccination, so its birds can lay at a higher rate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat buys about 10,000 tonnes of maize a year directly from growers in South Punjab, the main growing area.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat makes 100% of its own poultry feed and buys other feed ingredients directly from main producers or importers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said buying feed ingredients directly from main producers or importers protects quality and lowers cost.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said mixing its own feed lowers Wahdat's overall cost compared with buying finished feed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat runs three company-owned distribution centres, in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad, served by its own air-conditioned delivery vehicles.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat's policy is to keep eggs on retail shelves for no more than one week and to replace a faulty egg that a customer reports immediately.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said eggs are fragile and a broken egg in a pack can start to smell quickly, so owning distribution protects the brand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat distributes its eggs to about 1,500 retail outlets across Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat's operating footprint is two large farm houses with two sheds each, a pulp-based pack unit, three distribution centres and a head office.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat runs all its units on one comprehensive ERP system, and each unit is a self-managed, profit-oriented unit with its own monthly profitability reporting.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat says its farms are fully automated, with lights, feed, water, egg collection, temperature and manure disposal run by computer programmes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat says a farm can be sealed for 7, 10 or 15 days with no human entry while the birds' requirements are met on schedule.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said minimal human contact lowers disease risk, which keeps birds healthier and extends their life and productivity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat says it gives no antibiotics or other medicines to its birds and relies on vaccination and periodic blood testing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat vaccinates birds on a WHO-recommended schedule of about 23 vaccines for Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat periodically blood-tests its birds for immunity levels and re-vaccinates when a disease immunity level looks low.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat says it has had no major disease outbreak on its farms in 19 years, with only minor issues that it handles.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said the cost of vaccines, blood tests and feed is worth it because the flock gains productivity and a longer working life.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said disease is the main challenge in poultry, and weak feed lowers bird immunity, which raises susceptibility to disease.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said disease from poor hygiene and nutrition drives heavy medication on many farms, so disciplined hygiene reduces medicine cost.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO described Pakistan's egg market as largely informal, with eggs bought from local shops, and said hygiene and nutrition get little attention.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said many local poultry farms have heavy odour, frequent disease and heavy antibiotic use, which led Wahdat to build an international-standard farm.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said a visit to a branded, high-quality egg farm in southern France led him to plan a similar branded farm in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said he lived on Italian farms day and night to observe their operations and speak with owners and workers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat states it holds multiple hygiene certifications and regular quality controls, which the CEO cites as differences from informal egg supply.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: CEO Air Marshal (retired) Aurangzeb Khan was chairman of Pakistan Aeronautical Complex Kamra for four years, covering the JF-17 project from concept to production.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Aurangzeb Khan took a postgraduate diploma through IBA's evening programme starting in 1976, while a junior air force officer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said his air force training and project management experience shaped his planning, operations and maintenance discipline at Wahdat.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said he spent seven to eight years building poultry knowledge before the project started, including visits to farms in Turkey and Italy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO spent 15 days studying the Turkish poultry industry and stayed on farms to understand their operations and problems.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said he was attached to two American universities that help developing countries build awareness on poultry matters.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat has a nutritionist with a PhD and a second veterinary doctor on staff, which the CEO describes as among the best in the country.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat's quality control system was inherited under McDonald's International audit scheme, with trained staff ensuring its practices meet the target quality.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat approached McDonald's itself, and after an education phase and an external audit it cleared the audit at its first attempt.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat says its McDonald's supplier rating is A, and it is the only farm in the region that McDonald's has declared at international level.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat supplies eggs to McDonald's in Pakistan and Qatar.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat is planning an IPO and a listing on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat plans to raise about PKR 64 crore through its IPO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said the timing is right because no poultry farm has listed on Pakistan's exchange before.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said Wahdat meets listing standards on corporate governance, management and quality, and that its integrated model gives transparency over ingredients.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said large retail chains such as Imtiaz and Metro complain that Wahdat cannot honour their purchase orders, a sign that demand exceeds supply.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat has begun exporting eggs, and two UAE brands use its omega-3 eggs and have agreed to label them as Pakistan-produced.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said a third company is in its final stages of talks to take eggs for a large-scale brand launch.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said overseas buyers want specialised high-quality eggs, and high-end local customers show similar demand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat plans to build an egg pasteurisation plant with IPO proceeds, producing eggs it describes as bacteria-free and antibiotic-free.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said the pasteurised eggs would beat WHO standards for egg content, supporting export sales and high-end customers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat plans a licensing model in which partner farms keep their own birds, staff and management, while Wahdat supplies feed and veterinary cover.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Under the licensing model, partner farms would sell eggs to Wahdat at market rates, and Wahdat would use them for its branded and high-end products.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said the licensing model is capital-light, so Wahdat can get more output from less investment and both sides benefit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said licensed partners gain free nutrition and veterinary support, higher productivity and savings on medicine, since Wahdat uses no antibiotics.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat names three uses for IPO proceeds: an egg pasteurisation plant, a licensing model with partner farms, and working capital.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat says it needs working capital to support feed for its expanded production, which it plans to fund from the IPO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said expansion will be gradual and controlled, at a pace the company can manage and maintain.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat plans to use its high-end eggs across its own brands and activities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan's growing urban middle class and new housing societies are driving demand for branded eggs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said branded, enriched eggs cost more and are hard for ordinary consumers to afford.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said formal branded eggs make up a small share of total egg supply in Pakistan, due to limited awareness, education and facilities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Pakistan had no lab able to certify omega-3 content in eggs, so Wahdat sent its egg tests to Eurofins abroad.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said in-house distribution, own feed and the profit-centre structure together give Wahdat cost control that supports higher quality.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said conditions inside many local poultry farms are so odorous that a visitor cannot stay inside, which he cites as the gap Wahdat aims to fill.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: The CEO said Wahdat's cost control and integrated model let it absorb the higher expenses of quality, which he sees as a source of advantage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Initial customer discussions led Wahdat to believe that high-end customers in Pakistan would buy its high-quality pressurised eggs, according to the CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)

fact_text: Wahdat's pasteurisation plan targets high-quality pressurised eggs for both export markets and high-end customers in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Wahdat Poultry IPO: McDonald’s Egg Supplier Goes Public | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-15)
